summary: Learn to design and govern Power Platform and AppSheet workflows with controls, data quality, and practical business cases. Enrol today.
lede: Low-code/no-code workflow automation for finance, HR and operations teams helps turn manual approvals, requests, requisitions and reporting into structured digital workflows, forms, apps and dashboards. This course shows how to identify suitable processes, define requirements, validate data and measure improvements in cycle time, completeness, control execution and management visibility. You will practise using Power Platform concepts, Google AppSheet, BPMN process mapping and COBIT governance principles to design and document manageable automation releases. The training also covers validation rules, role-based access, exception handling, control matrices, testing, support procedures, reporting views and evidence-based business cases, while introducing connector risk, API concepts, AI-assisted expression generation and platform administration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own finance, HR, procurement, MEAL, operations, or digital transformation processes and need to convert manual work into controlled low-code/no-code automation. It suits beginner to intermediate business practitioners who can describe their workflows but do not need software development experience.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have practical experience with at least one finance, HR, procurement, MEAL, or operations process and basic familiarity with spreadsheets, workflow approvals, and business reporting. Bring one manual process suitable for analysis. Hands-on activities use demonstration or sandbox environments, so production credentials and confidential organisational data are not required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
